title: Cup of Tea
style: Warm lo-fi boom-bap, 88 BPM, swung drums and dusty piano chops; verse rides a tight focused pocket, pre-chorus strips to bass and rim clicks, chorus lands with clipped vocal doubles and a small sung chant. Red signal version stays sharp and driven while work moves forward, with tape hiss, vinyl crackle, and subtle reverse swells into each hook. Close-mic male vocals, intimate and steady, with ad-lib echoes on the anchor lines., lo-fi, theme, warm
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Red in the system, no time to drift
Cup stays warm while the commits hit
Hand on the mouse, eyes on the grid
One repo open, that’s how I live

The kettle just went
I let it breathe
Paper on the side
I don’t need speed

No gaps left, everything pulled in
Clean little line where the focus begins

[Pre-Chorus]
Signal is live
I don’t need to rush
Stack in the background
Keep the hush

Edge on the table
Work in view
If it turns red
I move right through

[Chorus]
Red on the desk, tea in the cup
(tea in the cup)
Signal is live, I don’t need to rush
(I don’t need to rush)
Stack in the background, tailscale locked
(tailscale locked)
One repo now, everything docked
(everything docked)

Red keeps the edge
While the work gets done
Cup stays warm
Till the job is won

[Verse 2]
Tabs stay low, but the mind stays loud
Little bright thought in a quiet cloud
Short reply, then I go right back
Tiny green line on a narrow track

Steam on the glass, lint on the sleeve
I make my move when the others leave
No gaps left, everything pulled in
Red keeps the edge while the work gets done

[Pre-Chorus]
Signal is live
I don’t need to rush
Stack in the background
Keep the hush

Edge on the table
Work in view
If it turns red
I move right through

[Chorus]
Red on the desk, tea in the cup
(tea in the cup)
Signal is live, I don’t need to rush
(I don’t need to rush)
Stack in the background, tailscale locked
(tailscale locked)
One repo now, everything docked
(everything docked)

Red keeps the edge
While the work gets done
Cup stays warm
Till the job is won

[Bridge]
Late note, clean hands
Still I stay in frame
No spill, no shake
Just the same old game

Heat in the mug
Cool in the head
I finish this one
Then I rest instead

[Final Chorus]
Red on the desk, tea in the cup
(tea in the cup)
Signal is live, I don’t need to rush
(I don’t need to rush)
Stack in the background, tailscale locked
(tailscale locked)
One repo now, everything docked
(everything docked)

Red keeps the edge
While the work gets done
Cup stays warm
Till the job is won
